context: A boss reviews a corporate IT team
purpose: Teach: 本田/石田/安田/川口/神田/大塚/野口/高木

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: IT統括、本田部長、引き続きお願いする。
lines.en: IT department — Director Honda, I'm counting on your continued leadership.
lines.style: Measured authority. Clean attack on the opening. Even pace. No inflection wasted. The tone of someone assigning responsibility and trusting it will land cleanly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。インフラは石田さん、安田さんが担当します。
lines.en: Yes. Infrastructure — Ishida-san and Yasuda-san will handle it.
lines.style: Professional confirmation. Slight nod in the voice at the opening. Declarative, efficient. The rhythm of someone reporting what's already been decided, delivering it without flourish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 川口さん、神田さんは、セキュリティ部門に異動。
lines.en: Kawaguchi-san and Kanda-san — moving to the security division.
lines.style: Clear directive. Pause slightly before the dash, like reading a list with precision. Calm, impersonal. The voice of someone stating facts that have weight but need no elaboration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 大塚さん、野口さんは、データ分析に注力します。
lines.en: Otsuka-san and Noguchi-san will concentrate their efforts on data analytics.
lines.style: Steady report. Even delivery, like checking items off a ledger. Mid-tempo, no stress. The sound of routine business being moved forward without drama.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 高木さん、AI推進、引き続き先頭で。
lines.en: Takagi-san — keep driving AI innovation forward.
lines.style: Brief, final note. Light emphasis on the name. Quiet confidence in the closing. The voice recognizing someone who's already carrying weight and will keep carrying it well.
